name: find-chars
description:
The characters of one type.

kind: "latin" (A-Z a-z), "cyrillic" (А..ӿ and Ё: not the capitals Є І Ї), "digits" (0-9), "letters_digits" (letters that have a case, and 0-9), "punctuation" (every other character but whitespace: also «-», «№» and letters without a case; a point or a comma between two digits is none, so «2.5» and «541,67» stay), "upper" (upper-case letters), "ua" (the Ukrainian letters і ї є ґ).

remove cuts the characters out; a punctuation character leaves a space («Диван-кровать» → «Диван кровать»). extract keeps latin, cyrillic and digits with the whitespace between them («120x200» → «120200»); for the other kinds it gives the runs joined by a space.

Example: semkit read --text "диван 120x200" --text "кресло" find-chars digits write -
-> диван 120x200, true; кресло, false

find-chars marks the rows where the matcher finds something, in a new column <column>_find of true and false.
